about.title: Three generations of craftsmanship in Monroe
paragraphs: For over 50 years, Cusumano Home Improvements has been the trusted choice for homeowners throughout Monroe, Michigan and the surrounding area. As a family-owned and operated business, we bring three generations of craftsmanship and experience to every project.

Whether it's a new garage, a covered porch or a fresh driveway, we treat your home like the investment it is. From the first estimate to the final cleanup, you work directly with the family that does the work.
points: Cash, check and major credit cards accepted

faq.a: We primarily serve Monroe, Michigan and surrounding areas including Temperance, Carleton, Flat Rock and nearby communities. For projects outside our usual area, contact us to talk it over.
Yes. Estimates are free and there's no obligation. Call or send a message to set up a time to talk about your project.

faq.q: What affects the price of a project?
faq.a: Size, materials, design, site conditions and the features you choose. Every project is different, which is why we give a free, detailed estimate for yours.

faq.q: How long has Cusumano been in business?
faq.a: Since 1974: more than 50 years serving Monroe and the surrounding area.
Yes. We carry all the licensing and insurance Michigan requires of home improvement contractors.
Cash, check and major credit cards. Payment terms and schedules are agreed during project planning.

faq.q: How long does a typical project take?
faq.a: It depends on scope, complexity and the weather. We'll give you a realistic timeline at your consultation and keep you updated as the work goes.
Yes, through our sister business, Cusumano Dumpster Rentals: 10, 15 and 20 yard dumpsters for 3, 5 or 7 days. See sizes, prices and booking on the dumpster rentals website.
